body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34572
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1673
Candidate reviewed: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1639 at `aae252eb457f1f0358ae4b98897f3a8fa6eda50d`

This PR contains an independent review report and preserved raw evidence only; it does not modify or duplicate the candidate patch.

Recommendation: request changes. The candidate is a substantive partial scheduler fix and its 24 protocol tests (plus 4 parameterized subtests) pass at the exact commit. However, an independent adversarial case shows that a repeated decision sequence with a different `(good, bad)` payload is silently ignored rather than raising on payload divergence. The original umbrella issue also includes the router replay prevention change tracked in upstream PR 34570, which this candidate does not contain. Therefore `fully_resolves_original` is false.

Reproduce:

- Baseline: `PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3aab1e38297c/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q /tmp/test_pp_abort_consensus_candidate.py`
- Candidate regressions: `/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3aab1e38297c/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_abort_consensus.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_hicache_prefetch_consensus.py`
- Independent adversarial test: `PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3aab1e38297c/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q /tmp/test_candidate_adversarial.py`

The environment exposed one gfx950 GPU, but the reported PP=8, Mooncake, HiCache L2-only, 32K shared-prefix cancellation-storm topology and model weights were unavailable. No full NCCL deadlock reproduction or soak is claimed. There are no native/C++ changes in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable. Full details are in `reports/j-3aab1e38297c/`.
title: Review PR 1639 against PP abort-storm issue
